3/ Memecoins: Born on Social Media

Projects like $DOGE, $SHIB all thrived because of internet culture.

They didn’t need a product.
They needed a vibe.
A community.
And one viral moment on X or TikTok. https://t.co/Ix1mgt3lqm

2/ The Lifecycle of a Viral Pump

Here’s how a typical trend-based rally happens:

👉 A narrative or meme starts (e.g., “AI + blockchain”, “Next $DOGE”)
👉 Influencers pick it up
👉 CT (Crypto Twitter) begins posting charts, memes, hype
👉 Retail FOMO kicks in
👉 Price surges
